References of a result or of the package

Source: R/references.R
bam_cite.Rd

bam_cite() gives the references of the methods behind a result of the package, or the references of every method in the package, as text or BibTeX. citation("bayesammi") cites the package and its main methods.

Usage

bam_cite(x = NULL, style = c("text", "bibtex"))

Arguments

x

a result of a function of the package, or NULL (default) for every reference of the package.

style

"text" (default) or "bibtex".

Value

An object of class bibentry (printed in the chosen style).

Author

Muhammad Yaseen (myaseen208@gmail.com)

Examples

bam_cite(
    x     = NULL
  , style = "text"
  )
